top_5_topics.title: Supreme Court Recognizes Right Against Climate Change Effects
top_5_topics.summary: The Supreme Court of India recognized the right to be free from the adverse effects of climate change as part of the fundamental rights under Article 14 (Right to Equality) and Article 21 (Right to Life).
top_5_topics.upsc_relevance: Fundamental Rights, Environmental Jurisprudence, Judicial Activism, Climate Governance.

top_5_topics.title: India Signs 10-Year Contract for Chabahar Port Operation
top_5_topics.summary: India Ports Global Limited (IPGL) signed a long-term agreement with Iran's Port and Maritime Organization to operate the Shahid Beheshti Terminal at Chabahar Port, boosting regional connectivity to Central Asia.
top_5_topics.upsc_relevance: India-Iran Relations, INSTC, Strategic Autonomy, Regional Connectivity, Middle East Geopolitics.

top_5_topics.title: RBI Surplus Transfer to the Central Government
top_5_topics.summary: The Reserve Bank of India approved a record surplus transfer to the Central Government for the fiscal year, driven by higher interest income on foreign assets and optimal risk buffer management under the Economic Capital Framework (ECF).
top_5_topics.upsc_relevance: Bimal Jalan Committee, Fiscal Deficit, Monetary Policy, Central Bank Autonomy.

top_5_topics.title: Negotiations for the Global Plastics Treaty (INC-4)
top_5_topics.summary: The fourth session of the Intergovernmental Negotiating Committee (INC-4) met to advance a legally binding international instrument on plastic pollution, including in the marine environment.
top_5_topics.upsc_relevance: UNEP, International Environmental Conventions, Waste Management, Single-Use Plastics.

top_5_topics.title: Aditya-L1 Mission Captures Solar Eruptions from L1 Point
top_5_topics.summary: ISRO's maiden solar mission, Aditya-L1, successfully observed major solar flares and Coronal Mass Ejections (CMEs) using its payloads, contributing to global space weather forecasting.
top_5_topics.upsc_relevance: Space Technology, ISRO Missions, Lagrange Points, Solar Physics, Space Weather.
